description.en: electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40 at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. 4 cm and below on the mixer The mixer prints 100 m / 300 m only
description.zh: 电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同见 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。搅拌泵是 4 cm 及以下。此处使用的电动40列表没有。

h1.en: Flow Units Converting Table is the heading; electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40 stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「流量 单位 换算表」，主体仍是电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40. The row to open is /products/integrated-mixer-pump. 4 cm and below on the mixer. The mixer prints 100 m / 300 m only. 100 / 125 mm is printed on the mixer. Electric 40 prints fine-stone and aggregate-13 rows. It is not printed on the Electric 40 list used here. Write both kilowatt numbers and 4500 kg to /en/contact/. Both pages print 21 m³/h and then different motor counts and weights. A transport note that uses 2300 kg for the mixer is the wrong machine. Electric 40 prints 45 kW only, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, two stone rows, no pipe diameter on the list used here, the same frame numbers and 2300 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the integrated mixer at main motor 45 kW plus mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 4500 kg. The section title “Online Fluid Flow Unit Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同的数字。要打开的行是 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。搅拌泵是 4 cm 及以下。此处使用的电动40列表没有。电动40印细石和 13 骨料两行。搅拌泵只印 100 m / 300 m。100 / 125 mm 印在搅拌泵上。两页都印 21 m³/h，然后电机数量和重量不同。运输说明如果给搅拌泵写 2300 kg，机器就错了。把两个千瓦数字和 4500 kg 写到 /zh/contact/。电动40只印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、两行石子，此处使用的列表没有管径，外形数字相同，重量 2300 kg。河北品锦机械（邢台）把搅拌泵一体机印成主电机 45 kW 加搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、4500 kg。节标题「在线 流体 流量 单位 计算器」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

Electric 40 prints 45 kW only, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, two stone rows, no pipe diameter on the list used here, the same frame numbers and 2300 kg.

body.en: For electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40, the heading “Flow Units Converting Table” does not replace a cell. The mixer prints 100 m / 300 m only. Write both kilowatt numbers and 4500 kg to /en/contact/. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the integrated mixer at main motor 45 kW plus mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 4500 kg.
body.zh: 对电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同而言，标题「流量 单位 换算表」并不替换任何格子。河北品锦机械（邢台）把搅拌泵一体机印成主电机 45 kW 加搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、4500 kg。把两个千瓦数字和 4500 kg 写到 /zh/contact/。搅拌泵只印 100 m / 300 m。

question.en: Does “Online Fluid Flow Unit Calculator” replace 4 cm and below on the mixer?
question.zh: 「在线 流体 流量 单位 计算器」会替换「搅拌泵是 4 cm 及以下。」吗？

answer.en: No. 4 cm and below on the mixer remains the printed wording for electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40.
answer.zh: 不会。搅拌泵是 4 cm 及以下。仍是电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The mixer prints 100 m / 300 m only belong on the electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40 row?
question.zh: 电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同这一行里，「此处使用的电动40列表没有。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/integrated-mixer-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/integrated-mixer-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Flow Units Converting Table” add to electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40?
question.zh: 「流量 单位 换算表」给电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-units-converter-d_405.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-units-converter-d_405.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
